h1: WaterColor "Sea'n Is Believ'en" 153 Silver Laurel Way
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS: *Per Watercolor HOA, please include all guests aged 5 and older in your total count of adult guests to receive amenity and pool access wristbands. Sleep arrangements are provided as a courtesy and are not considered in the occupancy count.**This home is allowed 12 amenity access bands.**- Located in Watercolor's most desired Park District- 2 blocks to the beach and beach club- Comfortable living room seating will make this space ideal for all ages- Wall-to-wall french doors open to expansive porches on both levels - Fully-equipped gourmet kitchen- Viking and Wolf appliances- 4 adult bikes - Complete Clean Linen Participant - ALL linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkoutGuests staying in WaterColor will have access to the newly expanded WaterColor Beach Club. It features a new main pool and lounge area, second pool deck with additional lounge seating, and third pool with zero-entry, as well an enhanced WaterColor Grill, and new sunset bar, Costa Chica. All have scenic views of the Gulf of Mexico.DETAILS: 153 Silver Laurel Way is the perfect location for a beach getaway for families and friends. This newly remodeled two-story, 4-bedroom/4-full, 1-half bath home is located on a large corner in the famed Park District. With its exceptional size of 3,000 square feet, this home is perfect for multiple families and sleeps 12. Enjoy all the nearby WaterColor amenities along with its close proximity to fabulous restaurants and unique shopping.This modern home is exceptionally comfortable and is perfect for families looking for an easy, carefree vacation. All of the rooms are spacious with the perfect beach vibe. Whether you are traveling with adults or children, there are plenty of spaces to relax, unwind, and enjoy! After a day at the beach or pool, enjoy an outside deck with a shower, comfortable seating, and a gas grill. A comfortable front porch, a private, screened porch off the downstairs primary, and a private porch off the upstairs primary, complete with a hanging bed, provides several places to watch the perfect sunsets. The upstairs media room with a queen pull-out couch, large TV, and table for eating or playing games is the perfect kid haven! The heart of this home is found in the oversized kitchen, dining, and den area. With a huge island complete with seating for 5 and a large dining table, this arrangement is great for cooking and eating in or bringing in meals from the many restaurant options within a 5 block radius. The kitchen is equipped with Viking stainless appliances, and all the kitchen cookware, bakeware, and utensils you will need are at your fingertips.The den is equipped with plenty of seating, a large flat-screen TV, and 3 sets of french doors leading out to the front porch. The home is equipped with WiFi and high-speed internet.SLEEPING ARRANGMENTS: FIRST FLOOR: - Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with walk-in Shower and Separate Tub- Private screened-in porch with access from primary and main livingSECOND FLOOR:- Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with walk-in Shower Only - upstairs porch off primary- Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed, Semi-Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo- Bunk Bedroom: 2 Sets of Pottery Barn Bunk Beds (Sleeps 4), Semi-Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo, Additional 1/2 Bath- Media Room: Queen Sleeper SofaWeddings are not allowed at this home. If this policy is violated, you may be asked to vacate the property and forfeit any rental payments, as well as be subject to HOA, community, and 360 Blue fines.Please note: Per HOA Policy, all Low-Speed Vehicle rentals in WaterColor must be made through The Electric Cart Company and will be limited to 80 vehicles throughout the community at any given time. Homes are permitted one Low-Speed Vehicle per home. Homes with owner provided Low-Speed Vehicles are not permitted to rent an additional Low-Speed Vehicle.
